findings_addressed.how: _check_single_symbol_conflict now treats absent (key missing or None) as the only annotatable case; any present dict, even empty or partial, must be fully canonical (str symbol exact, str direction exact, str mode specialist, exact int version) or it raises without rewriting.

Version validated by exact type and value (type(v) is int and v == 1, bool excluded); int() coercion removed from both check and validate paths so 1.5/1.0/True/False/str/None/Inf raise ValueError, never OverflowError; OverflowError added to every resumed-entry drop boundary (drop_invalid_single_symbol_rules, _validate_or_discard_island_artifact, specialist island annotation loop).

Added 8 focused tests (empty dict, missing symbol, missing direction, partial mode+version, non-string field types, coercive versions 1.5/1.0/True/False/str, Infinity validate+drop, Infinity standalone loader) and tightened bogus-routing assertions to pytest.raises(_cfg.ConfigError).
